parameters.name: modelUri
parameters.description: URI of the saved SameDiff model file (e.g., 'file:/path/to/model.fb', 'classpath:/models/model.fb').

parameters.name: outputNames
parameters.description: A list of strings representing the keys under which the output NDArray(s) from the model will be stored in the output Data object. These should match the names of output variables in the SameDiff graph.
